meaning: to lose one's job; be unemployed

senses.en: to lose one's job; be unemployed

note: Often 失业了 or 失业率 (unemployment rate).

examples.zh: 他去年失业了，现在正在找新工作。
examples.en: He lost his job last year and is looking for a new one now.

examples.zh: 你担心失业吗？
examples.en: Are you worried about losing your job?

examples.zh: 最近年轻人失业的问题很严重。
examples.en: Lately, unemployment among young people has been a serious problem.

meaning: to come to someone's home; to visit a customer's door

senses.en: to come to someone's home; to visit a customer's door

note: 上门服务 = home service; 送货上门 = delivery to your door.

examples.zh: 这家店可以上门服务。
examples.en: This shop can provide home service.

examples.zh: 医生明天会上门给他检查身体。
examples.en: The doctor will come to his home tomorrow to examine him.

examples.zh: 我们不提供上门服务。
examples.en: We do not offer home visits.

meaning: harvest; gain, reward (n.); to reap, gain (v.)

senses.en: harvest; gain, reward (n.); to reap, gain (v.)

note: Used for crops and for learning or experience: 很有收获.

examples.zh: 这次旅行，我的收获很大。
examples.en: I gained a lot from this trip.

examples.zh: 今年他们收获了很多苹果。
examples.en: This year they harvested a lot of apples.

examples.zh: 听了你的课，我很有收获。
examples.en: I got a lot out of your class.

note: 植物 is the general category; for a potted plant people say 盆栽.

examples.zh: 这种植物不需要太多水。
examples.en: This kind of plant does not need much water.

examples.zh: 动物和植物都需要阳光吗？
examples.en: Do both animals and plants need sunlight?

examples.zh: 我家阳台上有很多植物。
examples.en: There are many plants on the balcony of my home.

note: 塑料袋 = plastic bag; 塑料瓶 = plastic bottle.

examples.zh: 这个杯子是塑料的，不会破。
examples.en: This cup is plastic, so it won't break.

examples.zh: 请少用塑料袋，保护环境。
examples.en: Please use fewer plastic bags and protect the environment.

examples.zh: 我把塑料瓶放在桌子上了。
examples.en: I put the plastic bottle on the table.

meaning: from then on; from this point on

senses.en: from then on; from this point on

note: Starts a clause about a change after an event.

examples.zh: 搬家以后，他从此不再迟到了。
examples.en: After moving, he stopped being late.

examples.zh: 那次生病以后，她从此开始锻炼。
examples.en: After that illness, she started exercising from then on.

examples.zh: 他们在北京认识，从此成了好朋友。
examples.en: They met in Beijing and became good friends from then on.

note: 企业 is bigger or more formal than 公司; 大企业, 国有企业.

examples.zh: 这家企业有一千多个员工。
examples.en: This company has more than a thousand employees.

examples.zh: 他毕业后想去大企业工作。
examples.en: After graduating, he wants to work at a large company.

examples.zh: 很多企业都在找新员工。
examples.en: Many companies are looking for new staff.

note: Opposite of 富; 穷人 = poor people.

examples.zh: 他小时候家里很穷。
examples.en: His family was very poor when he was a child.

examples.zh: 我现在很穷，买不起车。
examples.en: I'm broke right now and can't afford a car.

examples.zh: 他不觉得自己穷，因为他很快乐。
examples.en: He doesn't feel poor, because he is happy.

meaning: to complain officially; to lodge a complaint

senses.en: to complain officially; to lodge a complaint

note: Made to a company or authority, e.g. 投诉电话 (complaint hotline).

examples.zh: 服务太差了，我要投诉他们。
examples.en: The service is terrible, I'm going to file a complaint.

examples.zh: 你可以打电话向经理投诉。
examples.en: You can phone the manager to complain.

examples.zh: 他们投诉过这家饭馆吗？
examples.en: Have they complained about this restaurant?

examples.zh: 请先下载这个文件。
examples.en: Please download this file first.

examples.zh: 我的手机下载不了照片。
examples.en: My phone can't download photos.

examples.zh: 你是在哪儿下载的这首歌？
examples.en: Where did you download this song?

meaning: climax; peak (of a story, event or activity)

senses.en: climax; peak (of a story, event or activity)

note: 掀起高潮 = set off a peak; 达到高潮 = reach a climax.

examples.zh: 这部电影的高潮很精彩。
examples.en: The climax of this movie is great.

examples.zh: 比赛到了高潮，大家都站起来了。
examples.en: The match reached its peak and everyone stood up.

examples.zh: 晚会的高潮是最后的表演。
examples.en: The climax of the party was the final performance.

note: Count by 一勺盐 or 一点盐; 粒 is for single grains.

examples.zh: 汤里要放一点盐。
examples.en: You need to put a little salt in the soup.

examples.zh: 医生说我应该少吃盐。
examples.en: The doctor says I should eat less salt.

examples.zh: 这个菜太咸了，盐放多了。
examples.en: This dish is too salty; too much salt went in.

meaning: to sell; to offer for sale

senses.en: to sell; to offer for sale

note: More formal than 卖; seen in notices, e.g. 出售二手车.

examples.zh: 这套房子正在出售。
examples.en: This apartment is for sale.

examples.zh: 本店出售各种新鲜水果。
examples.en: This shop sells all kinds of fresh fruit.

examples.zh: 他想出售自己的旧车。
examples.en: He wants to sell his old car.

note: 分散 can be a verb (scatter) or an adjective (scattered).

examples.zh: 他们分散在全国各地工作。
examples.en: They are scattered across the country for work.

examples.zh: 他们的家很分散，见面不方便。
examples.en: Their homes are spread out, so meeting is inconvenient.

examples.zh: 下课后，学生们分散到各个教室。
examples.en: After class, the students dispersed to various classrooms.

meaning: to stroll; to wander around, window-shop

senses.en: to stroll; to wander around, window-shop

note: 逛街 = go shopping or stroll along the streets.

examples.zh: 周末我们一起去逛街吧。
examples.en: Let's go window-shopping together this weekend.

examples.zh: 我不喜欢逛商店，太累了。
examples.en: I don't like wandering around shops; it's tiring.

examples.zh: 你来北京，我带你逛一逛。
examples.en: When you come to Beijing, I'll show you around.

note: Only before nouns: 大型超市, 大型活动.

examples.zh: 这里有一个大型超市。
examples.en: There is a large supermarket here.

examples.zh: 学校下个月要办大型活动。
examples.en: The school will hold a large event next month.

examples.zh: 他在一家大型医院工作。
examples.en: He works at a large hospital.

note: 官方网站 = official website; opposite of 民间.

examples.zh: 请看官方网站上的通知。
examples.en: Please look at the notice on the official website.

examples.zh: 这个消息官方还没公布。
examples.en: The authorities haven't announced this news yet.

examples.zh: 你应该在官方商店买手机。
examples.en: You should buy your phone from the official store.

meaning: to bask in the sun; to dry in the sun; to post and show off online

senses.en: to bask in the sun; to dry in the sun; to post and show off online

note: 晒太阳 = sunbathe; 晒被子 = air the quilt in the sun.

examples.zh: 今天天气好，我想晒被子。
examples.en: The weather is nice today; I want to air the quilt in the sun.

examples.zh: 猫喜欢在窗户旁边晒太阳。
examples.en: The cat likes to bask in the sun by the window.

examples.zh: 他在网上晒了孩子的照片。
examples.en: He posted photos of his child online.

note: Used for policies, rules and plans: 实施计划.

examples.zh: 这个新规定下个月开始实施。
examples.en: This new rule takes effect next month.

examples.zh: 公司已经实施了新的计划。
examples.en: The company has already carried out the new plan.

examples.zh: 这个办法很难实施。
examples.en: This method is hard to carry out.

note: Describes places, seats, climate; for how a person feels, use 舒服.

examples.zh: 这家酒店的床非常舒适。
examples.en: The beds at this hotel are very comfortable.

examples.zh: 我想找一个安静又舒适的房间。
examples.en: I'd like to find a quiet and comfortable room.

examples.zh: 这双鞋穿起来不太舒适。
examples.en: These shoes are not very comfortable to wear.
